name: Arifa H
headline: Human Resources Management Professional | Transformation Life Coach | UAE Labour Law Consultant | Fractional HR
about: I'm a Certified Human Resources Management Professional with expertise across HR operations, employee relations, UAE Labour Laws, recruitment, payroll, compliance, and performance management. I have led HR functions across diverse industries including financial services, IT, trading (retail), electrical & mechanical (retail, projects, and contracting), education, and beauty/wellness supporting multi-country teams and aligning people strategies with organizational goals.

What sets me apart is my ability to combine strategic HR partnering with a people-first approach. I've successfully implemented HR systems, developed policies, and led organizational change initiatives, while ensuring compliance and fostering engagement across diverse workforces.

Alongside my HR career, I am also a Certified Transformation Life Coach. This allows me to bring empathy, coaching, and development into my HR practice helping employees and leaders alike unlock their strengths, navigate challenges, and perform at their best.
I'm passionate about shaping positive workplace cultures, aligning people strategies with business growth, and creating meaningful employee experiences that drive retention and performance.

roles.title: Human Resources Manager
roles.desc: Lead end-to-end HR operations and office administration across multi-jurisdictional offices. Manage the full employee lifecycle for international teams, from recruitment to exit, while ensuring compliance with UAE Labor Law and global standards. Designed and implemented HR policies, spearheaded a company-wide HRMS rollout, and automated payroll and leave processes. Lead a team of HR professionals across multiple locations, enhancing operational efficiency and employee engagement by implementing data-driven strategies and performance metrics. Partner with senior management on labor law, compliance, and employee relations to mitigate risks and strengthen organizational culture. Drive employee engagement, retention, and performance initiatives, and support workforce planning and organizational restructuring during multi-country expansion. Administer employee benefits, including health insurance policies, to ensure compliance and satisfaction.

roles.title: Fractional HR Manager
roles.desc: Established and lead the HR function for the company's first retail showroom in Dubai, overseeing recruitment, onboarding, payroll, leave, and employee documentation. Built HR processes from the ground up, including policies, attendance, and leave management systems to ensure compliance and operational efficiency. Provide guidance on HR best practices and employee relations to foster a positive and productive work environment.

roles.title: Fractional HR Manager
roles.desc: Managed HR operations and office administration for the IT division, overseeing the full employee lifecycle, leave management, contracts, visas, and compliance. Handled onboarding and exit formalities with structured, compliant processes. Provided employee relations support and conflict resolution to maintain a positive work environment. Implemented HR policies and documentation to enhance operational efficiency.

roles.title: Group Senior HR Executive
roles.desc: Managed HR operations for 400+ employees across multiple business units, covering recruitment, payroll, compliance, and employee relations. Led full-cycle talent acquisition, onboarding, and induction processes while ensuring adherence to UAE labor law. Oversaw payroll, leave management, EOSB, and compensation and benefits administration. Introduced an Employee Happiness Survey and engagement initiatives to strengthen workplace culture. Provided employee counseling, conflict resolution, and HR advisory support to management.

roles.title: Group HR Recruiter
roles.desc: Managed full-cycle recruitment across diverse business units, ensuring timely hiring and a positive candidate experience. Prepared tailored job descriptions, coordinated with hiring managers, and conducted interviews. Oversaw job postings on multiple platforms, maintained recruitment trackers and staffing reports, and streamlined onboarding through timely offer letters and candidate communication.

roles.title: Administrator
roles.desc: Oversaw daily administrative operations, ensuring smooth workflow and team coordination. Managed databases, documentation, and financial processes including quotations, purchase orders, and invoices. Supported leadership with scheduling and calendar management, while contributing to marketing initiatives through website content updates. Maintained efficient internal communication to strengthen overall operational performance.
